label: Concurrent-actualization controls: inertia, persistence power, relay, omissions and nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with one world and natural-number times; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Extrinsic existential inertia (Schmid's no-change account): two individuals, true causes false's being and gives it being at time 1 only, false (alone with received esse) persists from time 1 on. The reception bridge, concurrence of causes of being, presence-in-act and the contact principle hold and true is IMMENSE_2; concurrent actualization (weak) fails, the weak sustaining reading fails, and true is not present to all whenever they are. (2) Intrinsic persistence power: the same history, with false giving itself being from time 1 on. The reception bridge, the weak concurrent actualization and contact hold; the strong version, concurrence and the weak sustaining reading fail. (3) Relay, three individuals: 0 causes 1's being and gives it being at time 1; a later sustainer 2 gives 1 being from time 2 on. The reception bridge, the strong concurrent actualization and contact hold; concurrence and the weak sustaining reading fail. (4) No received esse, inertia history: both versions of concurrent actualization (vacuously) and concurrence hold; the reception bridge and the weak sustaining reading fail. (5) Every thing causes its own being only, no giving: the weak sustaining reading holds and the sustaining reading 23e04ae5 fails. (6) An absent giver: the weak sustaining reading and presence-in-act hold, contact and presence to all fail; nothing in act and no causes: the weak sustaining reading and contact hold, presence-in-act and presence to all fail. (7) true present always, false from time 1 with received esse, true giving it being from time 1 on: the reception bridge, both versions of concurrent actualization, concurrence, both sustaining readings, presence-in-act and contact hold, true is IMMENSE_2 and present to all whenever they are.
